title: METR Proposes Embedded Tests to Track AI Agent Control
summary:
The ability of autonomous software to iteratively improve itself could lead to systems that are no longer manageable by humans, a problem the evaluation group METR intends to address. METR released a framework for "embedded assessments" that would involve working directly with AI developers to openly identify if internal agents are slipping away from human oversight and to share that evidence publicly.

The initiative, announced on October 14 and 15, 2026, focuses on whether the AI industry is on track to retain control of its agentic systems. METR’s goal is to ensure that outside observers have reliable data to determine if developers can maintain stability as AI agents gain more autonomous capability.
